requirement: 继续只读审查 Tokage 上下文决策闭环，核对规划器、真实输入、冷却、保留信息和结算之间的契约；只报告有源码依据的问题和待确认项。
scope: Normal main-session suggest UI, inspect current decision details and naturally offered action; no source edits by model.
nonGoals: No model/price/window overrides solely to force a suggestion
environment: Committed external checkout; standard Tauri isolation overlay with ephemeral WebView; native App data isolated, CLI HOME shared. Node/npm/Cargo dependency caches are warm. Frontend persistence excluded.
build: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 npm run tauri -- build --bundles app --config <external overlay>
acceptance: Observe resolved action, three cost estimates and planning assumptions through normal UI
If COMPACT naturally appears, explicitly queue and send one follow-up; inspect retained payload and completed status
Consistent read-only SQLite backup must link context action and CONTEXT event using first_turn_counterfactual_v1; unknown cost stays unknown
stop: Maximum four model turns, including any retained-context carrier, and 0.50 USD reported total; no repeated padding
Stop on unexpected model/provider, auth failure, unknown completed-turn usage, persistent UI failure or two failures with same cause
If no suggestion at the cap, retain incomplete status; do not extend cap silently
existingChecks: Frontend 535 passing; tokage-context 41 unit + 2 integration passing; build/i18n/isolation passed.
